capabilities: Add color, gradient, artwork, Unsplash, or image covers to notes with drag repositioning
Set note and folder icons from emoji, Lucide, or installed icon packs, shown in tabs, explorer, and links
Style individual notes with background, accent color, and font overrides
Install MIT-licensed icon packs from a settings picker
Show an expandable heading outline on the note's right edge
extras: Not yet in the community catalog, so it must be installed manually from release files. Some features (note background, per-note accent, colored names, custom fonts, download covers) are off by default and described as beta or experimental.
problem: Obsidian notes are plain text files with no visual covers or icons, making them look less identifiable than Notion pages.

relations.evidence: Add Notion-style covers and icons to your notes.

summary: Notion-style appearance plugin that adds covers, icons, per-note backgrounds, fonts, and accent colors to notes.
